facts.fact: StackAdapt announced on November 6, 2018 that it had been verified by the Trustworthy Accountability Group (TAG) and that its TAG-ID status is active in the TAG Registry.
facts.quote: today announced that it has been verified by the Trustworthy Accountability Group (TAG) and our TAG-ID status is active in the TAG Registry.

facts.fact: StackAdapt says it ranked highest in customer satisfaction and performance by G2 Crowd in the DSP category for the fourth time.
facts.quote: Ranking the highest in customer satisfaction and performance by G2 Crowd in the DSP category for the fourth time

facts.fact: StackAdapt states it ranks 6th in Deloitte's Technology Fast 50 ranking.
facts.quote: ranks 6th in Deloitte’s Technology Fast 50 ranking, and 23rd in Fast 500 in North America.

facts.fact: TAG describes itself as the first and only registered Information Sharing and Analysis Organization (ISAO) for the digital advertising industry.
facts.quote: TAG is the first and only registered Information Sharing and Analysis Organization (ISAO) for the digital advertising industry.
